summary.zh: 查看训练记录与体能趋势

description.zh: 读取活动记录、里程、配速与体能趋势，按时间或运动类型筛选。适合复盘训练或安排下周计划。首次连接在浏览器登录 Strava 授权，需要有效订阅。
description.en: Read activities, distance, pace, and fitness trends, filtered by date or sport. Useful for reviewing training or planning the next week. Sign in to Strava on first connect; an active subscription is required.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Strava 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Strava and authorize on first connect
